countRule: Seven logical work/collection groups; Broadmead has two editions, Ivimey thirteen physical HTML parts including the separately authored Gill prefix, Philadelphia twenty-seven selected pages. Not 46 books or a complete Philadelphia century.

works.title: A History of the English Baptists, Volume I (1811), offered components with Gill prefixed excerpt
authors: John Gill; Joseph Ivimey, 1811 volume compiler
Joseph Ivimey; publisher-added biography attributed to Baptist Encyclopedia (1881)
works.scope: Offered preface/front matter, ten chapters, notes and separately authored Gill prefixed historical excerpt; not Gill's whole treatise or Ivimey Volumes II-IV. Later publisher biography remains separately attributed.

works.title: Minutes of the Philadelphia Baptist Association (1851 Gillette edition): selected offered records and circulars
authors: H. G. Jones, preface author; A. D. Gillette, edition editor; Jim Duvall, web transcription
Philadelphia Baptist Association; A. D. Gillette, editor (1851); Jim Duvall, web transcription
works.scope: Twenty-seven offered readable pages: editorial front matter, early church histories, early-record parts, selected later minutes and three circulars; not the full 1707-1807 volume. Image-only statistics excluded.

works.title: The Records of a Church of Christ, Meeting in Broadmead, Bristol, 1640-1687
authors: Edward Terrill and continuators; Roger Hayden, editor
Edward Terrill and unidentified continuators; Edward Bean Underhill, editor
works.scope: Two overlapping offered existing OCR TXT editions: Underhill 1847 and Hayden 1974. Both preserve records with distinct editorial additions; not independently collated against the manuscript.
